crs_note: British National Grid. Every raster and vector in the pipeline is held in this CRS; OSM arrives in WGS84 degrees and is reprojected by step 01.
origin_note: South-west corner of the tile grid, in CRS units.
grid_res_note: Samples per tile edge. 513 = 512 + 1 so adjacent tiles share an identical edge row and there is no seam.
bbox_note: S,W,N,E -- Overpass order, which is not the order anything else here uses.
vertical_datum_note: Ordnance Datum Newlyn -- the datum of the EA LIDAR. Every elevation the pipeline emits, including water_level, is metres above this.

height_calib.note: height = intercept + m_per_level * building:levels. mode auto: step 07 regresses the line from this site's own buildings that carry both a building:levels tag and a trustworthy LIDAR p50, records the fit in massing_manifest.json, and uses it -- a town of Victorian terraces and one of post-war flats do not share a storey height, so this is measured, not assumed. fallback is used only if fewer than min_buildings qualify; these numbers are what the previous pipeline hardcoded for Margate and are of uncertain provenance (an earlier config claimed 1.83/2.58). Set mode fixed with intercept and m_per_level to pin values. A LIDAR p50 disagreeing with the line by more than dispute_m is tagged lidar_p50_disputed.

coast.note: foreshore_max_odn reclassifies low ground as sand rather than grass, and is a property of THIS survey: the EA flew Margate at low tide, so the intertidal flat reads as land. A site flown at high tide, or an inland one, wants this at or below water_level. rock_slope_deg is the slope ramp over which ground reads as rock -- tuned to the Cliftonville cliffs.

landmarks._note: Hand-authored overrides for buildings the LIDAR p50 estimator gets wrong, keyed by OSM name. Name-keyed matching is fragile -- an OSM rename silently drops the override, and step 07 reports how many applied so a drop is visible.

Arlington House.why: 18-storey tower on a large podium; p50 samples the podium (7.0m from 22px). Real height ~57m.

Jubilee Clock Tower.why: Tiny footprint (7px) undersamples the tower. Real height ~24m.
